app.name: bamboo
app.description: Manage your private mesh network from one console.

landing.title: bamboo
landing.subtitle: Sign in to manage your mesh.
landing.selfHosted: Running self-hosted? Use a pre-auth key in the CLI.

peers.title: Peers

newPeer.formHint: Mint a pre-auth key. Paste it into the bamboo client on the new device to connect.
newPeer.reusableHint: Default: one-time. Reusable keys can connect multiple devices and are useful for bulk-rollout but harder to rotate.
newPeer.resultHint: The pre-auth key below is shown only once. Copy it now — the controller stores only a hash and cannot recover the plaintext.
newPeer.qrHint: Scan with the bamboo iOS / macOS app to autofill all three fields.
newPeer.oneShotWarning: If you lose this key, mint a new one — there's no way to retrieve it.

peers.empty: No peers yet. Run bamboo up on a machine to register the first peer.

drawer.notFound: Peer not found. It may have been deleted, or the URL contains a stale id.
drawer.fetchError: Failed to load peer details. Try refreshing the page in a moment.

actions.confirmDelete: Delete this peer? This cannot be undone.

preAuthKeys.title: Pre-auth keys
preAuthKeys.subtitle: Admin-issued keys you paste into a bamboo client on a new device for its first connection. The plaintext is shown once at mint time; afterward only revocation is possible.
preAuthKeys.empty: No pre-auth keys yet. Go to Peers → Add peer to mint one.

acl.title: Access Policy
acl.empty: No access policy is configured. New tenants start with allow-all; tighten before going to production.

editor.staleRevision: Another admin just updated the policy. Cancel, refresh the page, then merge your changes.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: People currently in this tenant. New members are created automatically on first OIDC sign-in; invite and role-management flows are planned but not yet shipped.
users.empty: No users yet. The first account to sign in via OIDC becomes admin.

newInvite.formHint: Creates an invitation record. A one-time token is generated on submit; the redeem flow is still in progress, so hold off on sharing the token until that PR lands.
newInvite.isAdminHint: Admins can invite members, manage ACL, and revoke keys. Default is regular member.
newInvite.errorDuplicate: An active invitation already exists for this email. Revoke the existing one first.
newInvite.resultHint: The invitation token below is shown only once.
newInvite.resultHintEmailed: Invitation email sent to {email}. The token below is a backup — share manually only if needed.
newInvite.oneShotWarning: If you lose this token, revoke the invitation and create a new one — there's no way to retrieve it.
newInvite.redeemPendingWarning: ⚠ Redeem flow is not yet shipped — the invitee can't use this token to sign up yet. Wait for the accept-flow PR before sharing.
newInvite.emailNotConfigured: SMTP is not configured, so no email was sent. Copy the token below and share it with the invitee manually.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.empty: No invitations yet. Click "Invite user" above to create the first.

dns.title: DNS
dns.subtitle: Manage tenant DNS settings. This view is read-only; updates to MagicDNS and nameservers happen via the controller API today.
dns.magicDnsHint: When on, peers in this tenant resolve each other by short hostname under the tailnet namespace.
dns.nameserversEmpty: Not set — peers fall back to their local DNS.
dns.overrideHint: When on, tenant nameservers replace each peer's local DNS; when off, they're merged.

preAuthKeysCard.title: Pre-auth keys
preAuthKeysCard.description: Mint and revoke the keys that new devices paste into their bamboo client on first connection.

invite.title: You've been invited
invite.subtitle: An admin invited you to a bamboo tenant. Sign in with the email address the invitation was sent to; the system will accept the invitation and create your account automatically.

tokenMissing.title: Missing invite token
tokenMissing.body: This link doesn't include a ?token parameter. Ask the admin for the full invite link.

invite.emailHint: Sign in with the same email the invite was issued to — anything else is rejected.
invite.expiryHint: Invitations expire. Ask the admin to re-issue if the link no longer works.

unauthorized.title: Sign in to continue
unauthorized.body: This page needs an authenticated session. Sign in with the identity provider configured for your tenant.

forbidden.title: Admin access required
forbidden.body: Your account doesn't have permission to view this page. Ask a tenant admin to grant you the role.

unreachable.title: Couldn't reach the controller
unreachable.body: The controller didn't respond. Check your connection, then try again.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: The resource is gone, or the URL is stale.
